title: Desktop app: bypassPermissions mode still prompts for confirmation
body:
## Description

On the Claude Code **Desktop app (Windows 11)**, setting `permissions.defaultMode` to `"bypassPermissions"` in both global and project settings still prompts for confirmation on every tool use (Edit, Write, Bash, etc.).

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Set `~/.claude/settings.json`:
```json
{
  "permissions": {
    "allowedModes": ["default", "acceptEdits", "plan", "bypassPermissions"],
    "defaultMode": "bypassPermissions"
  }
}
```

2. Also set `.claude/settings.local.json` in the project:
```json
{
  "permissions": {
    "defaultMode": "bypassPermissions"
  }
}
```

3. Restart the Claude Code Desktop app
4. Use Shift+Tab to confirm the mode is set to bypass/auto
5. Try any tool use (e.g., Edit a file)

## Expected Behavior

Tools should execute without prompting for confirmation.

## Actual Behavior

Every tool use still shows a confirmation prompt that requires clicking to approve.

## Environment

- **App**: Claude Code Desktop (Windows)
- **OS**: Windows 11 Home China 10.0.26200
- **Shell**: bash (WSL)
- **Working directory**: WSL path (`\wsl$\Ubuntu\home\...`)

## Notes

- Both global (`~/.claude/settings.json`) and project-level (`.claude/settings.local.json`) configs have `"defaultMode": "bypassPermissions"` set correctly
- The UI mode selector also shows the correct mode
- Issue persists after app restart
author: ylytdeng

top_comments.author: houserooms
top_comments.body:
We are experiencing the same issue on macOS desktop app. We have tested all three bypass mechanisms (bypassPermissions, allow list, PreToolUse hook) — none work. Every tool call prompts. 15 days and counting.

Tracking our experience in detail at #38662, which also links to other related reports. This appears to be a systemic permissions architecture issue affecting multiple platforms.

top_comments.author: jgodboutPCS
top_comments.body: I am having a similar issue, but not getting confirmation on all prompts. I notice that when I run a skill, the permissions setting reverts back to accept edits on its own and does not stay in bypass permissions on mode. I have to continuously shift-tab to reset it back to the correct mode. However, while in this mode it does work (most of the time).
